reason: Expert explains that nightly CPU spikes on aggregation routers are caused by the backup job and are normal.

knowledge.summary: Nightly CPU spikes lasting around 14 minutes on aggregation routers are caused by the scheduled backup job and can be ignored unless exceeding 95% for more than 10 minutes.
knowledge.author: Antti Aalto
knowledge.details: Threshold for concern is CPU over 95% for more than 10 minutes.
